messages.author: 40fc57d53124bd8d
messages.subject: can i set minimum theta value in the fscores()
parts: I wonder if it is possible to set the minimum theta value in the fscores().

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: can i set minimum theta value in the fscores()
parts:
You can do this manually after estimating the scores. E.g.,

fs <- fscores(mod)
fs[fs < -5] <- -5

Phil
